title: Access Log Consent Summary
description: Data-collection consent dimension for aggregated access-log summary records, so consented vs non-consented traffic can be broken down via GROUP BY. Reuses the Adobe consent standard at the standard xdm:consents.xdm:collect path; xdm:val uses the standard choice values (y opt-in, n opt-out, p pending, u unknown, dy default opt-in, dn default opt-out). dy/dn represent the customer's configured default consent, applied to requests that carry no explicit consent signal. These fields are system-generated and not user-editable.

xdm:consents.title: Consents and Preferences
xdm:consents.description: Consent state resolved for the aggregated requests.

xdm:collect.title: Data Collection Consent
xdm:collect.description: Data-collection consent for the aggregated requests. xdm:val uses the Adobe consent standard choice values (y/n/p/u/dy/dn) and is intended as a grouping dimension. dy/dn represent the customer's configured default consent, applied when no explicit consent signal (CMP or WebSDK opt-out cookie) is present.
